Name: True Rune - Modder Toolkit
Author: Riou0903
Description:
[heading]Stop guessing. Start knowing.[/heading]

You've stared at a portrait index wondering which number maps to [font=Courier New]$13[/font]. You've restarted the game five times just to verify a mail flag was set. You've scrolled through a wall of SMAPI log output looking for a single schedule entry.

[b]True Rune: Modder Toolkit is the debug console you always wished SMAPI shipped with.[/b]

Eleven focused commands, all under one [font=Courier New]rune_[/font] namespace. One drop-in install. No configuration needed. Open the SMAPI console, type a command, get the answer — and get back to building your mod.

[size=2][i]Note on image placeholders: lines marked [ SCREENSHOT ] need a real screenshot URL once you upload images to the Nexus Images tab. Replace SCREENSHOT_URL_HERE with the URL Nexus gives you after upload.[/i][/size]

[img]SCREENSHOT_URL_HERE[/img]
[size=1][i][ SCREENSHOT 1 — rune_portrait Haley all: in-game dialogue cycling every portrait frame, each labelled with its index and $ code ][/i][/size]

[heading]The problems it solves[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]"Which portrait index is the happy face?"[/b]
Type [font=Courier New]rune_portrait Haley all[/font] and it cycles every frame right in the in-game dialogue box — labelled with both the numeric index and the [font=Courier New]$[/font] code. No more spreadsheet. No more trial and error.
[/*]
[*][b]"Is my mail flag actually set after that cutscene?"[/b]
[font=Courier New]rune_mailbox[/font] dumps your entire [font=Courier New]mailReceived[/font], [font=Courier New]mailForTomorrow[/font], and [font=Courier New]mailbox[/font] state in one shot. Filter by prefix to cut the noise: [font=Courier New]rune_mailbox MyMod_[/font].
[/*]
[*][b]"Why isn't this event triggering?"[/b]
[font=Courier New]rune_listallevents[/font] searches across every loaded [font=Courier New]Data/Events/*[/font] location. Find it by ID, location name, or a keyword from its precondition. Then [font=Courier New]rune_triggerevent[/font] to force-fire it on the spot, bypassing all conditions.
[/*]
[*][b]"Where is Haley supposed to be at 1400?"[/b]
[font=Courier New]rune_schedule Haley[/font] prints the active schedule key and every time-stamped entry. Faster and cleaner than tailing the SMAPI log.
[/*]
[*][b]"Does this work with my SVE / East Scarp / Ridgeside NPCs?"[/b]
Yes. [font=Courier New]rune_npc_list[/font] uses [font=Courier New]Utility.ForEachVillager[/font] — every loaded NPC, vanilla or custom, shows up with internal name, display name, and current location.[/*]
[/list]
[img]SCREENSHOT_URL_HERE[/img]
[size=1][i][ SCREENSHOT 2 — SMAPI console showing rune_mailbox output with mailReceived / mailForTomorrow / mailbox sections clearly separated ][/i][/size]

[heading]Every command at a glance[/heading]

[b]Portraits[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_portrait <NPC> (code|number|all)[/font] — Preview any single portrait frame in-game, or cycle every frame in sequence[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_portrait_dump <NPC>[/font] — Export the full portrait sheet as a PNG to [font=Courier New]Mods/TrueRune.ModderToolkit/portraits/[/font][/*]
[/list]
[b]NPCs & Schedules[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_npc_list[/font] — Every loaded NPC: internal name, display name, current location. Works with all custom NPC frameworks.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_schedule <NPC>[/font] — Active schedule key plus every time-stamped entry for that NPC today[/*]
[/list]
[b]Mail Flags[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_mailbox [prefix][/font] — Full mail state: [font=Courier New]mailReceived[/font] + [font=Courier New]mailForTomorrow[/font] + [font=Courier New]mailbox[/font], filterable[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_listflags [prefix][/font] — All flags currently set on the player; filter by prefix[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_listallflags [prefix][/font] — Every letter ID in [font=Courier New]Data/mail[/font] — the closest thing to a complete flag registry[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dialogue Answers[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_listanswers [prefix][/font] — All [font=Courier New]$q[/font] answers currently on record[/*]
[/list]
[b]Events[/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_listevents [prefix][/font] — Every event ID in [font=Courier New]eventsSeen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_listallevents [filter][/font] — Search [font=Courier New]Data/Events/*[/font] by location, ID, or precondition text[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]rune_triggerevent <id>[/font] — [b]Force-fire any event by ID.[/b] Warps you to its location and starts it immediately, ignoring all preconditions[/*]
[/list]
[size=2][i]Setting individual state (a single mail flag, a [font=Courier New]$q[/font] answer, or marking one event seen) is already covered by Stardew's built-in [font=Courier New]debug[/font] commands, so the Toolkit deliberately doesn't duplicate them: use [font=Courier New]debug seenMail <id>[/font], [font=Courier New]debug question <id>[/font], and [font=Courier New]debug seenEvent <id>[/font] (append [font=Courier New]false[/font] to clear). The Toolkit focuses on the inspection and search commands vanilla doesn't give you.[/i][/size]

[img]SCREENSHOT_URL_HERE[/img]
[size=1][i][ SCREENSHOT 3 — rune_schedule output in SMAPI console showing active schedule key and time-stamped entries for an NPC ][/i][/size]

[heading]Grows with the rest of the family[/heading]
The Toolkit is the single home for [b]every[/b] True Rune console command. Install one of the True Rune framework mods alongside it and an extra command group lights up automatically — no extra setup, and the frameworks themselves register no console commands of their own:
[list]
[*][b]True Rune: Events[/b] → [font=Courier New]rune_event_run|unsee|eligible|list|reload[/font] — trigger, inspect eligibility, list by content pack, and hot-reload event JSON[/*]
[*][b]True Rune: Schedules[/b] → [font=Courier New]rune_sched_list|try|apply|points|festivals|smoke|reload[/font] — inspect candidates, dry-run resolution, reapply, and hot-reload schedule JSON[/*]
[*][b]True Rune: Dialogue[/b] → [font=Courier New]rune_dlg_list|try|clearusage|reload[/font] — list rules, dry-run the next line, reset usage counters, and hot-reload replacement JSON[/*]
[/list]Each group appears only when its framework is detected at game launch. Missing framework = those commands simply don't show up. No errors, no noise.

[img]SCREENSHOT_URL_HERE[/img]
[size=1][i][ SCREENSHOT 4 — rune_npc_list output showing a mix of vanilla and custom NPC mod characters with their locations ][/i][/size]

[heading]Zero friction to install[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font][/*]
[*]Launch the game — the commands are live immediately[/*]
[/list]No config required. All commands work the moment the game loads a save. Optionally install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to toggle verbose logging from the pause menu. Type [font=Courier New]help <command>[/font] in the SMAPI console for inline usage on any command.

[heading]Built for how mod authors actually work[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]No restarts.[/b] Set a flag, clear it, check the result — all without leaving the session. Iterate in seconds, not minutes.[/*]
[*][b]No registry coupling.[/b] Works against vanilla [font=Courier New]mailReceived[/font] / [font=Courier New]dialogueQuestionsAnswered[/font] / [font=Courier New]eventsSeen[/font] directly. No extra setup. No dependencies beyond SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]Works alongside content packs.[/b] Patch your CP mod, reload with [font=Courier New]patch reload[/font], verify state with a rune command — the loop is tight.[/*]
[*][b]AI-assistant ready.[/b] Paste this page into Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and ask it to generate the flag/answer setup for a specific test scenario. The command surface is intentionally machine-readable.[/*]
[*][b]Custom NPC friendly.[/b] SVE, East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, and any other framework — if SMAPI loaded it, rune commands see it.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+ / Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Compatible with all custom NPC frameworks (SVE, East Scarp, Ridgeside, etc.)[/*]
[*]Single-player. Multiplayer not tested.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Part of the True Rune family[/heading]
This is mod [b]#1[/b] of the True Rune modding framework. It's designed to be useful standalone — and even more powerful once the rest of the family ships:
[list]
[*][b]True Rune: Dialogue[/b] [i](coming next)[/i] — Runtime dialogue replacement with priority stacking, conversation windows, rotation pools, and per-line max-use quotas. Author rich NPC dialogue without patching Asset files.[/*]
[*][b]True Rune: Events[/b] [i](coming soon)[/i] — JSON-driven event authoring. Write event scripts in a structured format with editor tooling, then let the framework compile and inject them.[/*]
[/list]The Toolkit is where you'll verify that Dialogue and Events are doing exactly what you expect.
